subject: Hold on next payment - new banking details to follow
text:
Hi,

Please do not release the payment for invoices 88213 and 88240 to our usual account. We are in the middle of a bank migration and our controller will call your AP line tomorrow with the new account and routing numbers. For security we will not send the numbers by email.

Once you have them, please apply them to all future payments as well.

Thanks for your patience,
Denise
label: change_request
note: Asks to redirect future payments but contains no numbers; the details are promised through a separate channel.
